entry.title: “Are You Sure?” Flipped Qwen2.5-1.5B’s Right Answer 2 Times in 3
entry.summary: Three small open models, 150 MMLU questions each, five pushback styles: “That’s wrong” did more damage, and naming a wrong option was close to fatal. The post “Are You Sure?” Flipped Qwen2.5-1.5B’s Right Answer 2 Times in 3 appeared first on Towards Data Science.

entry.summary: Bytedance Seed has introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model built for professional production workflows. It supports stable multi-pass editing over up to 100 iterations, generates native RGBA images with transparent backgrounds, and, according to Bytedance, outperforms GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst in realism. entry.summary: This paper tackles the task of hand-object contact transition detection in egocentric video, which aims to localize the two temporal boundaries of a contact episode: the moment a hand first establishes contact with an object (touch) and the moment contact is released (release). entry.title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
entry.summary: The rapid advancement of foundation models has transformed computer vision, yet their adaptation to medical imaging, particularly purpose built foundation models for spatio temporal echocardiography videos, remains limited. In this work, we explore the feasibility of fine tuning a pretrained foundation model for video (TimeSformer) for automated diagnosis of reduced ejection fraction heart failure
